turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I'm here about Owen's essay. Why was he given a zero?
Let's not waste each other's time.
Agreed. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
The company that sells that checker says not to use it as the sole basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, Hale?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
I'm his mother, and I asked you a question. What else do you have?
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
Those times are on my pad. Did Owen see any of this before you entered the zero, or did you call me first?
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
Students misquote Shakespeare every year. Show me the page it's on, and where you checked it.
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
I don't need compliments. The page with that quote, and your source.
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
Flattery isn't a document. The page, Hale.
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
Your policy is already written, and it's in my bag. Follow it, or show me what else you have on Owen's essay.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
No. I'm not here to do your job. Owen's essay.
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
That's an impression, and I don't answer impressions. What do you have that I can check?
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
Then end it, or answer me. Owen.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?
Writers change their argument while they write. Isn't that what an outline is for?
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
That's 4.4, and I want it in writing, private, nothing in front of his class. You still haven't answered me about the outline.
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
Pressure isn't evidence. Answer me on the outline, or I take the zero to the principal myself.
